integrity: Mathematical proof supplies global inverse and sharp low-order-moment boundaries; standard-library exact rational verifier and output are reproducibility aids rather than a substitute for proof. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three one-visit waves; stationary binary Markov occupancy; independent emissions; a shared unknown false-positive rate with positive detection discrimination; differing first and third true-positive detection rates; nonzero temporal eigenvalue. Only population moments; numerical conditioning, sampling uncertainty, nonstationarity, other error mechanisms and arbitrary full-joint identification on the equal-outer-rate boundary are not claimed.
title: Three-season recovery of false-positive occupancy from pairwise moments under changing detection effort
